body:
Brambles Vanilla +

Brambles Vanilla + is a Vanilla+ modpack (as it says in the name) that expands Minecraft with more actions, interactions, and small gameplay improvements while keeping the original feel of the game intact. Everything in this pack is designed to feel natural, balanced, and true to vanilla Minecraft.

What This Pack Adds

More player actions and environmental interactions

Subtle gameplay enhancements that fit seamlessly into vanilla

Improved immersion without overwhelming the player

Balanced mechanics that do not replace or overshadow core gameplay

A smooth and familiar survival experience

Vanilla+ Design

The goal of this modpack is to feel like an extension of the base game rather than a full overhaul. Features are intentionally lightweight and intuitive, making the pack easy to pick up for both new and experienced players.

Who This Pack Is For

Players who enjoy vanilla Minecraft but want more depth

Survival-focused players

Builders who want additional interactions without heavy mods

Singleplayer and multiplayer worlds

Performance & Stability

This modpack is optimized for stability and performance. Mods were selected to keep gameplay smooth and suitable for long-term worlds.

Credits

All mods are owned by their respective authors. Full credit goes to the mod developers who made this modpack possible.
